rows.note: Use this to add numbers up or total several amounts together.

example.english: The amounts add up to three hundred dollars this time.
example.traditional: 今次啲數加埋一共三百蚊。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 di1 sou3 gaa1 maai4 jat1 gung6 saam1 baak3 man1

rows.note: Use this when adding further information or appending a remark to what was said.

example.english: I’ll add one thing: remember to bring an umbrella.
example.jyutping: ngo5 bou2 cung1 jat1 geoi3 gei3 dak1 daai3 ze1

rows.note: Use this for the general sense of increasing an amount, level, or effect.

example.english: We need to add staff so we can finish on time.
example.traditional: 我哋要增加人手先趕得切。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zang1 gaa1 jan4 sau2 sin1 gon2 dak1 cit3

rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for physically adding or combining things, rather than summing figures.

example.english: Add some salt when you make the soup.
example.jyutping: bou1 tong1 go2 zan6 gaa1 di1 jim4
